title: Adaptive Cost Explorer Pivoting and Interruptible Modal Drilldowns
creator: Ava Morales
description: Goal: Rework the Cost Explorer pivot/listing surface and its modal-based drilldowns so the UI gracefully adapts across narrow and wide viewports, preserves row density for high-cardinality tables, and supports 'interruptible' modal flows that let users switch pivot dimensions without losing context. Scope includes table layout heuristics, chart canvas clipping fallbacks, modal stacking/anchor rules, and cross-browser rendering polish for Safari/Edge/Chrome at 100–1600px widths. Acceptance criteria: (1) pivoted table maintains readable density at 320–1366px with an explicit compact mode; (2) drilldown modals support keyboard-esc/escape-to-previous behavior and allow switching pivot keys mid-flow without data loss; (3) charts in drilldowns degrade from animated canvas to static SVG fallback on constrained browsers without layout jitter; (4) no visual regression in existing dashboards or rollouts pages in 3 major browsers.

dev_notes: Prefer CSS grid with container queries to drive density thresholds; fall back to flex column stack for older Safari versions
Virtualize rows with stable keying; when in compact mode, reduce padding and hide non-critical columns with an overflow menu
Charts: primary implementation uses WebGL canvas for throughput; implement a deterministic SVG fallback path that maps to same DOM bounding boxes to avoid layout shifts
Modal behavior: use anchored sheet pattern for <640px, and centered stacked modal for >=640px. Implement interruptible transitions that persist query state in URL fragment/query params
Performance target: first meaningful paint for drilldown <= 250ms on m3.medium equivalent with 50ms JS parse budget
accessibility_checks: Ensure pivot controls are reachable in a single tab order sweep
Add aria-live region for pivot-change summaries to inform screen reader users
Confirm color contrast of condensed row separators meets AA when density increases
Keyboard flow: ESC closes drilldown; SHIFT+TAB from first focus returns to pivot control
browser_buglog: Safari 15.6: canvas drawGroup causes flicker on high-DPI when using translateZ; workaround: composite layer disable for chart container
Edge (Chromium) 110: sticky header + transform on parent breaks intersection observer used for virtualization; implemented fallback scroll listener
Firefox 114: SVG text-anchor rendering differences require monospaced fallback for micro-labels at compact widths
